professionalSummary.text: Develops and maintains the alert queue and case views of the compliance web application using TypeScript and Angular, including server-side paging and column virtualisation that replaced full-queue downloads.
professionalSummary.witness: Developed and maintained the alert queue and case views of the compliance web application (TypeScript, Angular), including the server-side paging and column virtualisation that replaced the full-queue download.

professionalSummary.text: Owns the component test suite (Jest) and end-to-end test suite (Cypress) for the application, keeping both passing in the pipeline and adding a queue-load smoke test that gates releases.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the component test suite (Jest) and the end-to-end suite (Cypress) for the application, keeping both passing in the pipeline and adding a queue-load smoke test that gates releases.

professionalSummary.text: Reduced median alert-queue load time from 6.2 seconds to 1.4 seconds after implementing server-side paging and column virtualisation, measured by real-user monitoring against the published baseline of 6.2 seconds over four weeks.
professionalSummary.witness: Median alert-queue load time for analysts fell from 6.2 seconds to 1.4 seconds after the paging release, measured by the application's real-user monitoring over the following four weeks against the published baseline of 6.2 seconds.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated API changes with the backend team in API reviews, with backend lead approval of endpoint changes and adaptation of views to paged endpoints.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated API changes with the backend team in the API review; the backend lead approved endpoint changes and I adapted the views to the paged endpoints.

professionalSummary.text: Documented known limitations and hand-over conditions for each application release in release notes, including column sorting applied per page rather than across the whole queue and frontend on-call hand-over notes.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the release notes for each application release, including the known limitation that column sorting was applied per page rather than across the whole queue, and the hand-over notes for the frontend on-call.

experienceHighlights.text: Server-side paging and column virtualisation replaced full-queue downloads, improving alert-queue load time from 6.2s to 1.4s.

experienceHighlights.witness: Owned the component test suite (Jest) and the end-to-end suite (Cypress) for the application, keeping both passing in the pipeline and adding a queue-load smoke test that gates releases.
